_about: Z18: layouts verified in the 2016 zone (PDB export) and the 2016 client handlers. See docs/pseudocode/zone/Z18-leftovers.md.

0x2442.name: NC_BAT_SOMEONESKILLBASH_OBJ_CAST_CMD
0x2442.notes: broadcast to the caster's sight when a servant explosion (meb_Explosion, blastMode 2/4) fires a skill on an object; client: caster.ActSkill(target, 1, skill) unless the caster is the own character or the target is unknown

0x2443.name: NC_BAT_SOMEONESKILLBASH_FLD_CAST_CMD
0x2443.notes: broadcast to the caster's sight when a servant explosion (blastMode 1/3) fires a skill on a spot; client: SetSkillTargetGroundPoint + ActSkill(x, y, 1, skill) unless the caster is the own character

0x1c02.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_CHANGEDECORATE_CMD
0x1c02.basis: zone FUN_0063f910 (ItemAttrCls_Decoration::iac_equipbriefinfo) via so_ply_EquipmentChange FUN_0052ce60; client FUN_004a0710
0x1c02.notes: Decoration / CostumWeapon / CostumShield items; broadcast to sight by the view-slot functions; client: Char::Equip(item), slot 17 hides the aura

0x1c03.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_CHANGEUPGRADE_CMD
0x1c03.notes: Armor / Boot / Shield; client: CharShape::Equip(item, upgrade) + Char::Equip

0x1c04.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_UNEQUIP_CMD
0x1c04.basis: zone FUN_0063f7e0 (ItemAttributeClass::iac_equipbriefinfo, base class and item 0xFFFF); client FUN_004a08f0
0x1c04.notes: also sent for items of the 29 classes without own builder; client: Char::UnEquip(slot), weapon-title reset on slot 12

0x1c05.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_CHANGEWEAPON_CMD
fields: never written: stale g_buf byte (Z18-B10); client ignores it
0x1c05.notes: client: Char::Equip(item, upgrade); title type 10 shown and item class 5 → weapon title by (mob, level) or off for 0xFFFF

0x3029.name: NC_ITEM_SOMEONEUSE_CMD
0x3029.notes: broadcast to sight when UIE_Functions.broadcast is set; client plays the item's effect (ItemInfo InxName) on the user, useloc unread

0x206f.name: NC_ACT_SETITEMHEALEFFECT
0x206f.notes: broadcast around the object by RecoverTypeEffect::_execute; client: floating number (TextEffMgr::AddNumTextEff, style isheal*4|1)

0x3459.name: NC_ITEMDB_DESTROY_REQ
0x3459.basis: zone FUN_00527870 / FUN_00527b60 / FUN_00566f00 / FUN_0051c590 (sp_DestroyItem family, sp_ItemInvenDelete)
fields: bits 0-6 key count, bit 7 partial (rewritten cell valid)
payload offset of the attribute bytes (bit 7)
count entries; then the rewritten cell's attribute bytes
0x3459.notes: to the Character DB (sock2gameDB); answer 0x345A (Z05 §6.4); no 2016 PDB struct
